decision_clause: Ruled out “retrying on a bare 403” because many such responses are permission errors that waiting cannot fix; active for the four recorded collection paths.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: Invalid page counts and page sizes raise ValueError before the transport is contacted. Separately, a 403 without rate-limit evidence is treated as a permission failure and returned after one request; retrying occurs only when headers identify rate limiting and waiting is enabled.
rationale: The added implementation only performs pre-request paging validation. Within the active recorded scope, the finished code also expressly avoids the ruled-out behavior: a bare 403 is classified as forbidden and is neither slept on nor retried. Tests verify both the new validation and the single-request handling of permission-related 403 responses.
